flora: Coccolithophores (as a massive, milky-white underwater cloud)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; soft, ethereal clouds of micro-organisms; individual coccolith plates appear as tiny, shimmering iridescent discs; emphasis on the 'milky' quality of the water; rounded, appealing particles without sharp noise.

visual_logic.composition: A cinematic underwater view looking through a dense, milky-white bloom of coccoliths. The 'cloud' of algae swirls with the current, partially obscuring a distant phosphatic limestone reef.
visual_logic.ground: Soft white chalk dust and grey-marl pebbles on the seafloor, reflecting the high-key light from above.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright surface light filtering down as shimmering 'god-rays,' catching the individual plates to create a sparkling, crystalline effect.
